scope: Accessible EPUB 3 Reader header and footer navigation; sample opened from Library, then all recorded inputs target the newly opened Reader window146147222.

environment.nvda: 2026.2 portable AMD64, OneCore en_GB, add-ons disabled, isolated audit configuration
environment.method: Native computer-use sky keyboard/mouse input and actual NVDA diagnostic speech read as text; no acoustic listening; no DOM/CDP input
environment.logging: Temporary diagnostic logging disabled after tests; NVDA left running

result: One confirmed Name Role Value defect in the sampled progress-track interaction; remaining observations are qualified below. No application-wide conformance claim.

header.detail: Skip, Close Reader, Information, TTS, TTS options, Search, Bookmark, Annotation, Navigation, Reader settings and Zen mode are named. Bookmark/Annotation announce unchecked; toggles expose sampled pressed/expanded states. Close Reader, TTS playback, Bookmark and Annotation were focused only.
Enter opens About publication, Close is announced, Escape dismisses, and NVDA+Tab confirms Information focused/collapsed.

Search opens a named edit; two observed Escapes return to its unpressed trigger. Navigation/Settings Enter toggles announce expanded and collapsed; opening Navigation displayed the last Search section. Deep panel actions and search results were not tested.

Enter activates Zen; NVDA+Tab reports document focus. Tab reaches named Exit Zen mode; Enter restores chrome. Entry/exit itself produced no mode speech in the scoped interval. Subsequent Tab starts at Close Reader rather than restoring the Zen trigger.
Enter announces main content, main landmark and publication frame.

footer.check: History names, states and keyboard order
footer.detail: Back/Forward are named and initially unavailable. Tab/Shift+Tab reach them, and Enter on unavailable Back leaves the sampled chapter unchanged. After a mouse progress jump, Back becomes available; Enter returns to Talk to Me, Forward becomes available, Space revisits Using Code Examples, and Back restores Talk to Me.

footer.check: Page navigation controls adjacent to publication
footer.detail: Go forward is keyboard reachable, Enter visibly changes page, NVDA+Tab confirms retained Go forward focus, Shift+Tab reaches Go backward, and Space returns to the previous page. These are side arrows, evaluated alongside footer navigation.

footer.result: confirmed naming defect; keyboard-equivalence coverage unresolved
footer.detail: Ordinary Tab from history Forward wraps to Skip to content, omitting the track. A mouse click changes chapter and exposes unnamed buttons. NVDA+Tab announces only button focused.

findings.status: D/S confirmed in sampled current-branch scope
findings.source: track_reading_wrapper has aria-hidden=true (line288). Each track segment is a span role=button within Focusable excludeFromTabOrder (lines373-375), with an onClick navigation handler but no accessible destination name.
findings.observed: Mouse click at x300/y806 jumps from Talk to Me: Media Overlays to Using Code Examples. Native focus query says button focused with no name. Captured UIA exposes a group of unnamed buttons after activation.
findings.impact: A screen-reader user who lands on the segment cannot identify its purpose or destination. Normal Tab navigation skips it.
findings.recommendation: Provide a named keyboard-operable progress/destination control with accurate current position, or a fully equivalent accessible navigation path; remove interactive content from aria-hidden. Label each destination and verify keyboard focus/value announcements.
findings.qualification: Only the missing-name failure is assigned here. TOC alternatives, all progress-track functions and effective customized shortcuts were not exhaustively evaluated, so no additional general2.1.1 failure is assigned.

observations.detail: First TTS options opening shows a blank playback-rate field and speaks its label twice plus blank. Down exposes1x, option9 of59. After list dismissal the collapsed input speaks1x. ReaderHeader.tsx supplies both label and aria-label. No rate option was committed and playback was not started.
Some initial Escapes do not dismiss a list/panel; subsequent Escape does. No general Escape failure is assigned without separating focus/browse-mode interception.

Ctrl+PageDown from history and after Skip to content, plus Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Right from content, caused no observed chapter change. These defaults exist in src/common/keyboard.ts, but effective customization and NVDA interception were not ruled out. No shortcut pass or general keyboard failure is claimed.

Page/history changes are visible, but the sampled action speech intervals contain no destination/page completion announcement beyond control availability. No4.1.3 failure assigned solely from this observation.

boundaries: All recorded audit actions stay in Reader146147222 after Library launch. Another pre-existing Reader27723318 remains open; it was only observed during initial window selection, with no input sent.
Close Reader is focus-only to honor Reader-only scope. No bookmark/annotation creation, deletion, TTS playback, acquisitions or external communication.
One English EPUB, paginated default view; no PDF/fixed-layout/audio, RTL, all themes/locales, complete reflow/contrast or acoustic assessment.
No source changes, commit or push performed.

finalState.history: Forward entry retained from the test; no history deletion attempted
finalState.publicationPosition: Restored to the same chapter/start page; exact caret position not guaranteed

evidence.assertions: Passed against recorded native speech and trees; this summarizer does not run fresh UI tests
evidence.contentHandling: Publication webview subtree/document prose omitted; control trees and scoped speech retained

remediation.status: Fixed in sampled scope on codex/a11y-reader-progress-track; baseline findings and evidence preserved below.
